summary: TopBuild Corp. filed an 8-K on April 18, 2026, disclosing a merger agreement with QXO, Inc. Under the deal, each TopBuild share will be converted into either $505 cash or 20.200 QXO shares, subject to proration. The TopBuild board unanimously approved the merger and recommends stockholder adoption. The merger will occur in two steps: first TopBuild merges into a QXO subsidiary, then into another subsidiary. A break fee is not disclosed. What to watch: stockholder mix elections and antitrust/regulatory clearance timelines affecting the risk-arb spread.
